A '''species''' of [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] inhabited the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. About the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] thumb, the insects were capable of flight and buzzed as they did so. They also possessed stingers, which made them dangerous to other large animals if the bugs were in a swarm. The bugs would flee if faced with smoke, meaning smoking them out was an effective strategy to combat the insects. By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a group of hundreds of the bugs had made their home in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] ''[[34 Besh]]'', a pod from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], which crashed on Cholganna at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a previous [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict. The group swarmed anything which approached the pod.<ref name="BTR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the Galactic Civil War a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] attempting to locate the ''Sa Nalaor'' investigated escape pod ''34 Besh'' and were swarmed by the insects living inside.<ref name="BTR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The insects first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The insects are used in the book as a obstacle players need to overcome to investigate the escape pod, which was an optional task.
